reuse.why: Every month-wide action already goes through isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories, and the flag is added there rather than handled per action.

duplication.why: The hidden-category rule is changed once in isMonthFillCategory; the actions only pass the flag through.

placement.why: The rule change sits in the shared selection function in budget/actions.ts, which owns month-wide category selection.

scope.why: Only the flag, its threading through the six month-wide actions, and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; the flag is a second positional boolean beside the MonthFillRules object rather than part of it, and the rewritten visibility check is slightly more verbose than the old one.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions, including copyPreviousMonth, call isMonthFillCategory with the flag

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the per-action changes are only parameter threading
